items.text: Senior Applied NLP & LLM Engineer with 6 years of experience shipping retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, domain-adapted language models, and automated evaluation suites in Python.

entries.heading: Senior Applied AI Engineer | Briarwood Support Cloud | 2022 – Present

items.text: Architected a multi-tenant retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline in Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO) serving 140k daily customer-support queries across 85 enterprise tenants with 99.9% uptime.

Migrated 18M embedded knowledge-base passages from Pinecone to self-hosted Qdrant with scalar quantization and custom HNSW parameters, cutting p95 vector retrieval latency from 92ms to 24ms and saving $4.2k/month.
Fine-tuned Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B checkpoints using QLoRA and DoRA adapters on 4x A100 GPUs to specialize in insurance policy summarization, matching GPT-4 win-rates at 6x lower per-token cost.

Built a nightly LLM-as-a-judge grading harness verifying groundedness, factual attribution, and unsupported claim rates across 2,400 golden test cases, automatically blocking releases when quality thresholds regressed.

Implemented hybrid semantic search combining SPLADE sparse lexical expansion, dense BGE-large embeddings, and cross-encoder reranking, boosting top-5 recall by 19 percentage points on long-tail acronym queries.

Engineered system prompts, constrained decoding with Pydantic JSON schemas, and function-calling routers to orchestrate multi-step billing resolution tools, raising autonomous resolution from 61% to 84%.
Cached external CRM REST API responses in Redis with a 15-minute TTL and speculative prefetching of customer account metadata to trim end-to-end webhook latency.
Curated, filtered, and deduplicated 45B tokens of domain support transcripts using MinHashLSH and Ray Data on GKE spot node pools.
Deployed pre-inference input sanitizers to block jailbreak attempts and regex+Presidio NER scrubbers to strip customer SSNs, payment card numbers, and medical identifiers prior to model invocation.
Generated synthetic adversarial question-answering sets from policy change logs to stress-test citation grounding before production model swaps.

Embedded with claims adjusters and underwriting leads for three weeks to shadow manual policy reviews, turning their decision heuristics into an automated clause-extraction copilot adopted by 320 adjusters.
Mentored 3 mid-level ML engineers on embedding model selection, chunking strategies, and on-call incident runbooks.
Trained RoBERTa and DeBERTa sequence classifiers in PyTorch to extract indemnification, governing-law, and termination clauses from commercial contracts with 0.91 macro-F1.
Led on-call incident rotations and delivered prompt triage of customer escalations during quarterly filing traffic spikes.
Trained linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) and TF-IDF baselines in scikit-learn to benchmark legacy document routing taxonomies.
Authored the 2022 technical vision document laying out the team's migration roadmap from rule-based regex parsers to transformer encoders.
Built an active-learning annotation queue in Prodigy and PostgreSQL (pgvector prototype) that cut paralegal labeling hours by 35%.
Created a Python CLI for versioning Jinja2 prompt templates, running A/B prompt evaluations against OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and exporting cost/latency diffs (650+ GitHub stars).
Added JSON Schema validation and retry-with-error-feedback loops for malformed tool-call outputs.
Co-organizer of the Austin Applied NLP Meetup; hosted monthly paper reading groups on retrieval and alignment.
Volunteered with the Texas Open Weightlifting Foundation to modernize their regional tournament scoring spreadsheets and live leaderboard.
